description: An audited operation on the platform: a configuration change, or a token issued (objectIdentity issue). Activity logs are read only.  The list can be filtered with q on user, operation, success, objectIdentity, objectID, objectName and date. A date condition sets the time window, which is the last 30 days by default. Conditions can only be combined with and. The list is ordered by date (order=date or order=-date, the default) and is paginated with after and limit.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

claims.description: The claims of the caller, or of the token issued.
claims.title: claims

error.description: The error of the operation, if it failed.
error.title: error

objectDiff.description: The change made to the object, if any.
objectDiff.title: objectDiff

objectID.description: The ID of the object of the operation, if any.
objectID.title: objectID

objectIdentity.description: The identity of the object of the operation, issue for a token issued.
objectIdentity.title: objectIdentity

objectName.description: The name of the object of the operation, if any.
objectName.title: objectName

title: ActivityLog
